root_cause: Offline shell (erp-offline-shell-auth) requires localStorage rateb_erp_offline_scope with company_id+user_id. Persist only ran late inside erp-shell-bootstrap boot after a tenant gate on window cfg — often never written before going offline. offline-shell.html had no early restore of identity into __RATEB_ERP_SHELL_OFFLINE__.
unrelated_not_fixed: oa flag false during shell snapshot in one probe (tenant gate still cleared; modules opened without tenant errors).
role_ids / permissions_version empty in layout cfg (not emitted by PHP session into __RATEB_ERP_SHELL_OFFLINE__); identity still valid with company_id+user_id.
auth_unlock/rbac.cache flags false for this admin session — PIN unlock path not exercised; not required once tenant context present.
